title: echosig_manifest
description: EchoForge echosig_manifest document. Indexes a packaged 'echosig' artifact: the named tensor axes, the on-disk tensor paths, and any QA report paths that ship with the bundle. Conforms to the EchoForge strict-open contract: deterministic id, public-proxy provenance, and validation envelope.

id.description: Deterministic EchoForge id of the form ef:<kind>:<public_proxy_id>:<16hex>:1. Derived from the identity-field payload.

kind.description: Document kind discriminator. Always the literal string 'echosig_manifest' for this schema.

schema_version.description: EchoForge schema version pin. Must equal '1.0.0' for this revision of the contract.

public_proxy_id.description: Stable, human-readable slug identifying the public-proxy artifact (lowercase letters, digits, and ._- separators). Forms part of the deterministic id.

provenance.description: Provenance envelope: how the document was produced, source references, generator, timestamp, and payload fingerprint.

license.description: License envelope (SPDX id and optional notice) under which the echosig manifest content is released.

validation.description: Validation envelope: tier, overall status, uncertainty score, and the per-check results that establish trust in this document.

artifact_name.description: Human-readable echosig artifact name shown in tools and reports. Non-empty free text.

object_card_id.description: Deterministic id of the object_card document this echosig artifact corresponds to.

tensor_axes.description: Axis labels for the packaged tensors, in declaration order. The required label set for a complete EchoForge echosig is: frequency_hz, azimuth_deg, elevation_deg, tx_polarization, rx_polarization, geometry_variant, material_variant, attitude_state, motion_state, propulsor_state, solver_regime. Each entry is a non-empty string.

tensor_paths.description: Relative paths (under the bundle root) to the tensor payload files, typically of the form tensors/*.zarr. Each entry is a non-empty string.

qa_paths.description: Relative paths (under the bundle root) to QA report files, typically of the form qa/*.json. May be empty if no QA artifacts ship with the bundle.
